question: Men starting a prostate drug were either told or not told it may cause sexual problems. How did reported problems compare?
options: About the same in both groups
Nearly three times as common when told
answer: Nearly three times as common when told: 44% against 15%, on the same drug. Warned men watched for the problem, noticed ordinary lapses and blamed the pill, and worry itself can cause the effect. Honest consent has a cost, so how a side effect is described matters.
move: Whatever you are told to watch for, you will find more of.
ask: What am I noticing more often lately simply because someone told me to look out for it?
trap: About the same in both groups, since the drug acts the same way.
source: Mondaini et al., J Sex Med, 2007
reference: Mondaini et al., Finasteride 5 mg and sexual side effects: how many of these are related to a nocebo phenomenon?, Journal of Sexual Medicine, 2007
